question: Can a cache built from Sentinel-2 be kept alive with new Sentinel-1 (radar) acquisitions instead of new S2 images? Only a multi-modal FM (OlmoEarth encodes sentinel1 into the same token space) can attempt this; single-sensor FMs cannot.
setup: Sen12 T1 dev folds (hiroshima, thrissur, chimanimani, newzealand). State = S2 window [0:4] (teacher e4). Teacher = S2 window [0:12] (unchanged, so results are comparable to MS-116). New observations per step = single-acquisition OlmoEarth embeddings of the S1-ascending images nearest in date to the two new S2 dates (gap days recorded).

arms.gru_both: mean of S2 and S1 singles

metrics: identical to MS-116 (frozen decoder AP recovery, decoder seed 1; agreement)

rule.cross_sensor_works: gru_s1 recovery >= 70% in >= 3 of 4 folds (S2 baseline is 77-95%)
rule.complementary: gru_both > gru_s2 by >= 2 points in >= 3 of 4 folds
rule.fail: gru_s1 < 40% everywhere: radar singles do not carry the optical state forward on this task

not_claimed: timestamps: S1 dates are real acquisition dates, gaps to S2 dates reported
